mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case_run (id, case_id, workspace_id, status, note, bug_task_id, executed_by, executed_by_user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{caseId}, #{workspaceId}, #{status}, #{note}, #{bugTaskId}, #{executedBy}, #{executedByUserId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM test_case_run WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case_run SET bug_task_id = #{bugTaskId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_case_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND case_id = #{caseId}
